fields.description: Issue includes editorials and political commentary on the upcoming Miami municipal election and city commissioner candidates, with discussion of taxes, bond issues, and public-utility franchises (including Florida Power & Light). Coverage also addresses gambling and the pari-mutuel racing controversy in Dade County, including criticism of newspaper treatment of anti-racing views. Additional pieces touch on Everglades fires, proposals for a new county for Miami Beach, Florida gasoline taxes, Memorial Day reflections, and local civic and social items; includes political advertisements and notices related to Lions Club events and Miami/Miami Beach entertainment and tourism.
